description: TPOT (Olson et al. 2016), the AutoML tool Dr. Luitel asked about, as a classical baseline: genetic programming over scikit-learn pipelines on the eGeMAPS v02 functionals, z-scored per speaker, with the settings of the TPOT paper (100 generations of 100 pipelines) and TPOT's default operators. Every pipeline is fitted on the 3 training sessions and scored by UA on the validation session (the rule every model here follows); the winner, refitted on the training sessions, predicts the test session. A search stops after 45 minutes if the generations are not done. TPOT's search is random, so 5 seeds. Runs on CPUs in the classical environment, not in the GPU queue.
